# TrevRPC QMux golden vectors (draft-ietf-quic-qmux-02).
# Each entry is hex. Every implementation must encode the frame, parameter,
# record and message entries byte for byte, and decode them back.
#
# varint.*      RFC 9000 Appendix A.1 variable-length integers.
# frame.*       single frames.
# params.*      QX_TRANSPORT_PARAMETERS frames.
# record.*      Size-prefixed records (QMux over TLS).
# message.*     the same frames as one WebSocket message (no Size).
# invalid.<error>.*  frames that must be rejected with <error>
#               (frame_encoding or transport_parameter).

varint.1byte = 25
varint.2byte = 7bbd
varint.4byte = 9d7f3e7d
varint.8byte = c2197c5eff14e88c

# STREAM id 0, "hi", FIN.
frame.stream.fin = 0b00026869
# STREAM id 4, offset 16, "hi".
frame.stream.offset = 0e0410026869
# RESET_STREAM id 0, code 1, final size 5.
frame.reset_stream = 04000105
# STOP_SENDING id 0, code 1.
frame.stop_sending = 050001
# MAX_DATA 65.
frame.max_data = 104041
# MAX_STREAM_DATA id 4, 1028.
frame.max_stream_data = 11044404
# MAX_STREAMS (bidirectional) 65.
frame.max_streams_bidi = 124041
# CONNECTION_CLOSE (application) code 0, "bye".
frame.application_close = 1d0003627965
# CONNECTION_CLOSE (transport) PROTOCOL_VIOLATION, frame type 0x08, no reason.
frame.transport_close = 1c0a0800
# QX_PING request and response, sequence 1.
frame.ping = f48c67529ef8c7bd01
frame.ping_response = f48c67529ef8c7be01

# max_idle_timeout 30000 ms, initial_max_data 16777216,
# initial_max_stream_data_bidi_remote 4194308, initial_max_streams_bidi 65,
# max_record_size 65536.
params.server = ff5153300d0a0d0a2301048000753004048100000006048040000408024041c571c59429cd08450480010000
# initial_max_stream_data_bidi_local 4194308, initial_max_data 4194308,
# max_record_size 65536.
params.client = ff5153300d0a0d0a19040480400004050480400004c571c59429cd08450480010000

record.stream_and_max_data = 080b00026869104041
message.stream_and_max_data = 0b00026869104041

invalid.frame_encoding.ack = 0200000000
invalid.frame_encoding.quic_ping = 01
invalid.frame_encoding.crypto = 06000000
invalid.frame_encoding.new_token = 0700
invalid.frame_encoding.datagram = 3000
invalid.frame_encoding.truncated_stream = 0b00056869
invalid.frame_encoding.truncated_varint = 1040
invalid.transport_parameter.original_destination_connection_id = ff5153300d0a0d0a020000
invalid.transport_parameter.small_max_record_size = ff5153300d0a0d0a0bc571c59429cd08450243e8
invalid.transport_parameter.duplicate = ff5153300d0a0d0a06040101040102
